data.translation: "So kommt, wir wollen den Esel begraben", sagte der Fuchs, "der Widder soll das Totenhemd nähen; der Hase soll das Grab offen legen, und der Hahn soll Priester sein und die Leichenceremonien vollziehen." "So soll es sein", antworteten jene.

summary: All 7 occurrences checked. Stem II remains specifically funeral accompaniment in future promises, assigned rites and completed funeral narratives. No separate general-following sense is inferred from it.
PrS 73/42 mlawele is Infectum in the ṭro ... howe ... construction, despite matching the written Preterit base. A surface form alone does not settle its box.
37/14 lewoyo names the funeral rite in an elliptical list of liturgical books. It is the entry's existing Infinitiv example, not another independently narrated burial.

MAC NE Famine/55 dlawəlle has unresolved segmentation and lexical affiliation. The English 'haven't birthed yet' is not enough to derive a reproductive sense from I follow/stay near; young-goat terms also leave mating possible. Reject the supplied lwy analysis as unestablished and admit no example.
Existing examples at 33/97, 35/70, 37/14 and 94/49 are retained without duplicates or replacing their translation language. The uncertain classicism question in I stays unchanged.
Identify and segment dlawəlle in MAC NE Famine/55 from recording or speaker judgment. Is it about mating, giving birth or something else, and is it lwy at all?
Verify the analysis lawəlle = lawәn ele and the relation between the lwele and lawi paradigms without treating the equation as another corpus example.
